title: S37 — Ensemble reader: vote between v3, v4, and classic floor readers
desc: Different readers fail on different images. Ensemble voting may reduce error rate. Method: (1) run all three readers (classic floor, glyphcnn-v3, glyphcnn-v4) on hard suite; (2) implement majority voting (2-of-3 agreement); (3) measure ensemble accuracy vs individual readers; (4) if improvement > 3%, wire into pipeline as 'ensemble' route. Owner: marcus-aurelius. Priority: 3. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
